dialect.detail: IBM IMS COBOL program using z/OS Connect EE V3 API Requester (BAQCSTUB/BAQCTERM) to call external REST APIs; uses CBLTDLI for IMS DL/I calls; copyright IBM Corp. 2020

purpose.domain_detail: Insurance claims processing — evaluates DRUG, DENTAL, and MEDICAL claims by calling an external REST API via z/OS Connect EE; runs as an IMS MPP/BMP transaction
purpose.summary: IMSCLAIM is an IMS COBOL program that reads input messages from an IMS message queue, calls an external REST API (via z/OS Connect EE BAQCSTUB) to evaluate insurance claims, and writes the result (ACCEPTED/REJECTED/ERROR) back to the IMS output queue. It handles DRUG, DENTAL, and MEDICAL claim types and includes error handling for API, z/OS Connect EE server, and stub-level failures.

notable_features: IMS DL/I calls via CBLTDLI (GU, ISRT)
z/OS Connect EE API Requester pattern (BAQCSTUB/BAQCTERM)
PROCEDURE DIVISION USING IO-PCB-MASK (IMS PCB linkage)
COMP-5 SYNC for binary pointer/length fields
COMP-3 packed decimal for monetary amount
COPY copybooks: BAQRINFO, CLAIMREQ, CLAIMRSP, CLAIMINF, IMSCLAIC
EVALUATE TRUE for multi-condition error dispatch
verdict.notes: Program type classified as online-cics enum value but is actually an IMS online MPP transaction (no CICS); 'online-cics' is the closest available enum. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but all major logic is visible. Apache License 2.0 IBM sample code, but structured as a realistic production pattern.
